Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
1. Riddle Phantastique: ...The minion with this cards burns 1 riddle counter
instead of untapping during his or her untap phase...
If the minion already is untapped, can it burn a counter anyway?
2. Unwholesime Bond. ...gains X+1 blood where X is the bumber of untapped
Blood Brothers of the same circle as the acting vampire.
Is the acting vampire tapped before the count of untapped vampires is made?
3. Kiss of the Lachesis. Is TEM of this card an equipaction, for example
does the acting vampire untap after fetxhing a leather jacket?

Henrik

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henrik wrote:
>
> 1. Riddle Phantastique: ...The minion with this cards burns 1 riddle counter
> instead of untapping during his or her untap phase...
> If the minion already is untapped, can it burn a counter anyway?

Yes.

> 2. Unwholesime Bond. ...gains X+1 blood where X is the bumber of untapped
> Blood Brothers of the same circle as the acting vampire.
> Is the acting vampire tapped before the count of untapped vampires is made?

Tapped. [6.2.1]

> 3. Kiss of the Lachesis. Is TEM of this card an equipaction, for example
> does the acting vampire untap after fetxhing a leather jacket?

No. It's a "move card" action, not an "equip" action (card text).
